description:
Decode label-coverage assertion configuration into a typed form with a compiled pattern when rules load.

## Background

Graph assertions `LabelCoverage`, `LabelReference` and `DependencyShape` hold raw `toml::value::Table` payloads (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:577-590,923-927`), and evaluation reads their keys on each call, so a malformed rule surfaces only during evaluation. Typed `Raw*` structs lowered at load are the existing pattern (`rules.rs:940-1089`), and `RuleConfigError::InvalidAssertion` names the rule. Rule serialization renders the tables with `render_config_table` (`repository_state/rule_serialize.rs:267-275,366-396`). Label-coverage keys are read at `validation/graph.rs:855-946`, its regex is compiled at `:869`, and `require_str`/`optional_str` read the table. `commands/graph.rs:404-409` reads `satisfies-namespace` and `container-from-label` from the raw table, and `validation/desugar.rs:60-62,627-635` builds the table. `test_label_coverage_malformed_config_is_config_error` (`graph.rs:2421`) and `test_child_type_exclude_must_be_array_of_strings` (`:2590`) reach evaluation with malformed tables.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `LabelCoverage` holds a typed configuration with its kind sugar, `child-state` as a `State`, its child link as an enum and its pattern as an `IdPattern`; the raw table, `require_str` and `optional_str` are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: A malformed label-coverage assertion fails rule loading with an error naming the rule, and its evaluation compiles no regex.
- [hard] REQ-03: Readers of label-coverage options outside validation read the typed fields.
- [hard] REQ-04: Rule serialization emits the same keys for a typed label-coverage assertion.
title: Label-coverage assertions are typed and compiled at load
